content: Iesu Sinbirabobai aurin Sitarasisib

Ra ruam nanaba si’yen weie Forag wabin Baisobon a Rafi Sarar Men Fio Yist Auman on an Ra gagamin itgat. Priest aiwabis a Baifafaro an baibebeotis on eta sinunuen mamaba Iesu bubuniai nan sitfatumai ato sitasubun mes.
Osi siyau, “Ot men forag an rai on bobo tanafour mes, sabu arimon fetag sinitai siniyatatab ato sinigagam.”
Iesu on Bethany nan Simutai

Iesu on Bethany nan Simon an goai, on orot on usin gawud komasin bag on ibo. Iesu on bayu i’yam ato jever kibub agimai sibiyamai on amonai on fio yanden ninibin awan bonuin auman ibo irui goa amonai, on fio wawanin ninibin an baiyan on gagamin bag. Jever kibub matan iturutob ato fio Iesu tefanai idebur.
Sabu fani nan simama on yas sitatab ato tous wat siyau bonen, “Abi yabin aurin on fio yanden ninibin on fetagai idebur?
On fio on sabu fani auris ititotobon on arimon agim 300.00 kina on tefanai nanaba itboai ato on agim on itboai sabu kokoianis itites!” Ato osi on yatatabai nan jever sigam siyawur.
Baise Iesu iyau, “Omi on jever on asir woikirir mom! Omi aibo mes wobisababanai i? On bobo on obin fafa bag auriu ifour.
Omi arimon ra fufur sabu kokoianis on mat wonama ato wera tani wongogoi mes on wonibaisis. Baise Yau on arimon men ra fufur mat wantoan tanama on.
On aifan an gogoi on ifour; on fio yanden ninibin usiui idebur on ainau ebotitiwag Yau singarobiu mes.
Yau awurem dura bag menan nan tafanam au engonai wasagobin sinbibino on, jever bobo aifan auriu ifofour on arimon on aurin sinnos sinidudurai.”
Judas Ibasit Iesu Itkaseirai Mes
Namon Judas Iscariot, baigibubunuotin tani, on inai priest aiwabis auris mamaba itafour Iesu osi auris itkaseirai mes.
Judas dura aifan iyawures on siyasisir ato siyaumatanai agim sititai mes. On mes Judas ibosuruf eta inunuen menan wera obin itgaturai nan Iesu osi auris itkaseirai mes.
Iesu An Baigibubunuotis mat Baisobon an Bayu Siyam

Rafi Sarar Men Fio Yist Auman an Forag Ra ainauin, on ra nan on foro sheep bobous siyasububunuen Baisobon an bayu am aurin ato baigibubunuotis on Iesu sitetemai siyau, “Om menan nan egogoi wanan Baisobon an bayu aurim wanbotitiwag?”

Namon Iesu an baigibubunuotis ruam iyafares sinai, On dura ato nanaba iyawures iyau, “Omi wonan Jerusalem mafam gagamin amonai wonar, ato orot sareu kibub iyabar enat on arimon mat woninofoten. Ato omi on orot wonigibubunuai wonan
ato on inan goa amonai inrurur ato omi goa matuanin on wonawur wonau: ‘Baibebeotin iyau, goa amonai efan menan nan au baigibubunuotis mat Baisobon an bayu wanam i?’
Namon on arimon goa gagamin ann weromin nan efan sirereb sibotitiwag yen on iniyoboem, ato omi on efanai nan arimon aifan engon aurit on wonbotitiwag.”
Baigibubunuotis sigat sinai mafam gagamin amonai sirui ato Iesu dura mamaba i’yawures on engon tutufin sigaturen; ato osi Baisobon an bayu on sibotitiwag.
Ibirabirabi ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam on mat sinat.
Osi kemai simairirin bayu si’yam ato Iesu iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag omi orot tani on arimon Yau inkaseiriu—omi orot tani Yau mat bayu tam on.”
Baigibubunuotis on siyababan ato sibosuruf kakaita kakaita On sibitetemai si’yau, “Om dura bag men yau auriu ebikakafun i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Arimon omi baigibubunuotim auyotoat sasagis ruam sanamui, on orot iyafan an rafi sarar Yau rui ramo amonai wanbibiwan on.
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, Orot Natun min arimon inarab; baise orot iyafan Orot Natun inkakaseirai on, on aurin on komasin bag! Iyobin on orot on men itarat mes!”
Bada An Bayu
Osi bayu si’yam Iesu rafi sarar turin ibo, God aurin bayoi ikakaiu, iyabaseseb ato an baigibubunuotis ites. On iyawures iyau, “Atonio rafi sarar wobo wam, nin on Yau usiu.”
Namon On viga ibo God aurin ikakaiu, ato an baigibubunuotis ites ato osi engon tutufin on viga emon sitoman.
Iesu iyau, “Atonio on Yau au tara on indebur sabu engon tutufin auris, Yau au tara on God an dura bobaibasit boboun.
Yau awurem dura bag, Yau men arimon atonio sareu wine antoman men, ab Yau God an Baiaiwab amonai anar weie Yau sareu wine boboun antoman.”
Namon osi kwarer tani sikwarer ato sigat sinai Olive Oyau aurin.
Iesu on Peter Iyawur arimon Inisosouf

Iesu osi auris iyau, “Omi engon tutufin arimon wonayai kirireu, yabin God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘God arimon foro sheep kaifarotin inasubun ato foro sheep on arimon engon fetag fetag sintagege.’
Baise on gibunai God rabob emon inbobaimisireu an yayawas on Yau ainau namui anan au Galilee.”
Peter iyafotai iyau, “Yau men meyan arimon anikirirem on, basit osi fani on arimon sinayai!”
Iesu on Peter aurin iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag om arimon wera ton nanaba unau yau on Orot on men asagobai weie kokorerek bairuin ari fom inatou.”
Peter dura wawaninai iyafotai men iyau, “Yau arimon men meyan dura nanaba anau yau men asagobim mat on eb yau on arimon rut tanarab!” Ato baigibubunuotis fani engon min on dura kaitamom sikakafun.
Iesu Gethsemene nan Ibabayoi
Osi sinat efan wabin Gethsemene nan ato Iesu an baigibubunuotis auris iyau, “Omi nin womair wonmama ato Yau anan nan an bayoi.”
Iesu on Peter, James a John on iboes mat sinai. On nunuan on ikomas ibit kwakwan,
ato On osi auris iyau, “Yau nunuaui yababan on irat kwakwan kafakakai mom nunuau intaseb. Omi nin wonama ato matam woneit.”
On kafakakai wat inai mabinai, ato magin ainau motobai ifeu ato ibayoi iyau on fofonin men arimon baikokosar an wera amonai itar.
On ibayoi iyau, “Tamau, Yau Tamau! Bobo engon tutufin aurim on fofonim wat. Atonio baikokosar an viga Yau emon ebo enai. Men Yau au gogoiai baise Om am gogoiai anafour.”
Namon On imatabir men inai ato an baigibubunuotis ton igatures siyenbubur. On Peter aurin iyau, “Simon, om yenbubur? Om men fofonin wera kaitamom wat matam uteit utama?”
Ato osi auris ikakafun iyau, “Omi matam nana wo’neit ato wonbayoi arimon men rutobon wonboai on. Omi nunuam on egogoi bobo obin inafour baise usim on sesasam.”
On imatabir men inai ibayoi, dura kaitamom min on iyau men.
Namon On imatabir men inat an baigibubunuotis auris ato igatures siyenbubur: Osi men fofonin matas siteit sitama on. Ato osi men sisagob arimon abi dura aurin sitikakafun.
On wera baitonin ba imatabir men inat ato auris iyau, “Omi on nana wobiyarir a woienbubur? Fofonin! Wera inat nono! Woit, Orot Natun on ari sabu bokomasotis imasi seyayagai.
Omi womisir tanan. Woit, orot atonio on Yau ekakaseiriu!”
Iesu Sifatumai

Iesu on dura nana ibikakafun ato Judas, baigibubunuotis auyotoat sasagis ruam tani on inat. On sabu kuayo mat sinat, osi imasi on seri a sambeyan aumas siboen sinat, ato osi on priest aiwabis, Baifafaro an baibebeotis a sabu kawian on sabu siyafares sinai.
Orot kaseirotin on sabu kuayo gagamin asi baiyoboen ites: On iyau, “Orot ato rereban ayayanin on wogogoiai. Omi wonfatumai ato wonboai wonan, wonkaifarai tiwag.”
Judas inat mom, on inai Iesu aurin ato iyau, “Baibebeotim, ato on rereban iyan.
Ato osi Iesu sifatumai aumiet bag sibotan.
Baise osi sabu fani nan sitatawar sanasi orot tani on an seri ibo ato Priest Ainauin an agirotin tainan iyasutin itutu.
Namon Iesu ikakafun ato iyawures iyau, “Omi aibo mes seri a sambeyan aumas woboen wonat Yau wonfatumeu mes, Yau on yakeotiu bait?
Yau ra fufur omi mat tafaror goai nan sabu abibebeyes ato omi men nan wotfatumeu. Baise God an dura buk amonai sigayam on inat ebidur bag.”
Namon baigibubunuotis engon tutufin Iesu sikirir siyayai sinai.
Jorei tani on beber neneyan kakakaiin iyot ato Iesu ibigibubunuai. Osi sifourtobon on jorei sitrous sitfatumai mes,
baise osi imas siyof on an beber wat on sibokikin sibotan ato on jorei on kereremotin iyayai inai.
Iesu Jew Babadis Rurubinis Nasi Itawar
Namon Iesu sibo sinai Jew asi Priest Ainauin an goai. priest aiwabis, sabu kawian a Baifafaro an baibebeotis on engon nan siruayo.
Peter on nanenei nan igibubunues inai Priest Ainauin an goa furi on amonai irui. On nan imair sabu kaifarotis mat wairaf iraranis.
Priest aiwabis a Jew Babadis Rurubinis engon tutufin sifourtobon Iesu aurin dura sitsagob tiwag onai sitirabobai; baise osi on men dura yabin tani sigaturai on.
Sabu sigaraba asi dura baisigogo Iesu aurin sikakafun, baise asi dudur on men siyamai kaitamom imatar on.
Namon sabu fani simisir Iesu aurin ato baisigogo dura siyau,
“Wei watatamai On iyau, ‘Yau arimon atonio tafaror goa sabu imasi siyoyonin on agoros, namon ra ton insawar gibunai Yau goa tani boboun anyon, on goa on men sabu imasi siyoyonin ba on.’”
Baise osi asi dudur on men meyan siyamai kaitamom imatar on.
Priest Ainauin imisir sabu engon tutufin nasi itawar Iesu itetemai iyau, “Om am baiyafot mamaba unau atonio osi sabu asi dudur aurim sibikakafun on?”
Baise Iesu awan ifot men dura tani ikakafun on. Priest Ainauin Iesu itetemai men iyau, “Om min Keriso, God Baimomogin on Natun?”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Yau are, ato omi sabu engon tutufin arimon Orot Natun wonitai God Faiwarin maiau an asumaiauai inamair safam an kasakasauai innanat!”
Priest Ainauin an beber amonai iyote on isafef yabin on Iesu an dura ikakafun on inos wat ato iyau, “Yau men agogoi sabu dura fani ba sinkasoneu men!
Omi baigigim dura God aurin ibikakafun on ato wotatam. Ato omi ami bainonot on mamaba?” Osi engon tutufin Iesu aurin siyau, “On bobo komasin ifour on mes inarab.”
Sabu fani sibosuruf Iesu sikakan tuturai, ato osi beber sibo Iesu matan siyous ato sirarabin si’yau, “Om yawurei tait iyafan irabim!” Ato sabu tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis on Iesu sibo siyasfarai.
Peter on Iesu Isosoufai
Peter on nana nan furi amonai goa gosfunai imama ato Priest Ainauin an agirotin jeverei tani on inat.
Jeverei iyeit Peter it wairaf iraranai, ato on totor wat aurin iyau, “Om mat on Iesu Nazareth emon an baigibubunuotin tani.”
Baise Peter isosouf iyau, “Yau men asagob... Yau men asagob om aifan aurin ebikakafun,” ato on goa emon ibib igat inai furi awanai namon kokorerek itou.
Jeverei agirotin on Peter nan it ato ibosuruf dura kaitamom min on sabu nan sitatawar auris iyau men, “On Iesu an baigibubunuotin tani!”
Baise Peter isosouf men. Men weromin sabu nan sitatawar on Peter siyawur men siyau, “Om men unisosouf mes, om on osi asi orot tani, yabin om mat on Galilee emon.”
Namon Peter iyau, “Yau aurim abifaro, dura bag wat abikakafun! Yau anbibisigo mes on God yau inimakieu, on Orot aurin wobikakafun on yau men asagobai on!”

Men weromin kokorerek ra bairuin itou ato Peter inos mamaba Iesu aurin i’yau on, On iyau, “Om arimon auriu ra ton unisosoufiu unau, yau On Orot on men asagobai weie kokorerek bairuin inatou.” Ato Peter men sunub itou on.
